body: CHIEF DIRECTION RECORDED: dynamic semantic zoom is accepted and should not wait on recall. The provider contract already has both ZoomLevel axes and conservation laws, but StoryAtlas hardcodes SurfaceDetail.Hidden. Local bead bd-01M16KD7WBWKTQC6CENE9V67Q0 owns exposing and exercising the independent surface axis after L1(b) releases AppCompiler; it must conserve Address across representation changes, not merely magnify the same SVG. Foreign ruling: storymodel4s post-01M16KBGN1MZKKD68XCV3N8MTE.
